name: verification-agents
description: Proposer and verifier agent pairs for research: literature scouting with citation chaining, prior-art discovery, and dataset profiling, each checked by an independent adversarial verifier.

library_check_command.title: Library check command
library_check_command.description: Optional. A command that reads DOIs on standard input, one per line, and prints the ones already in your reference library, exiting with an error if it can't check. The literature scout marks those [HAVE]. Leave empty to skip the check.

library_import_command.title: Library import command
library_import_command.description: Optional. A command that takes a finished lit-scout-iterate run folder as its one argument, imports the papers listed in its verified-claims.jsonl into your reference library, and prints a Markdown summary. Leave empty to skip the import.

verification_log_command.title: Verification log command
verification_log_command.description: Optional. A command run after each verifier finishes, given three arguments: the verifier's name, the path to its verdicts file (corrections.jsonl), and a short run label. For keeping your own record of how often verification finds faults. Leave empty to skip.
